Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/02/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 123 as introduced could increase, by an undetermined amount, the financial and administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Veterans Affairs, subject to approval by the State Board of Veterans' Affairs, to educate, recognize and promote the mission of the State Board of Veterans' Affairs to veterans, the public, and other public agencies. This bill also clarifies the responsibilities that must be met by the counties to maintain a county service commissioner office.
Tom Butler, Chairperson
Veterans and Military Affairs

Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/22/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 123 as passed the Senate could increase the financial and administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Veterans Affairs, by an undetermined amount, subject to approval by the State Board of Veterans' Affairs, to educate, recognize and promote the mission of the State Board of Veterans' Affairs to veterans, the public, and other public agencies. This bill also clarifies the expenses that must be paid by the counties to maintain a county service commissioner office.
Dickie Drake, Chair
Military and Veterans Affairs

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Reynolds
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 66 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the Board of Nursing until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
